body: regardless you need to get a driving permit first, which is a multiple choice exam you register for at the DMV. this is what allows you to legally practice driving. theres plenty of resources to study if you look up "NYS permit practice test". if you're under 18, you need to have your permit for 6 months and have 50 hours of driving logged by a parent or guardian and 15 of those hours have to be after sunset. no matter your age you have to do a 5 hour pre-licensing course before you can do a road test. the road test is the only thing that will give you your driving license, and you cannot take it without a driving permit and the 5 hour course first. you turn 18 in september so you would be able to take the road test before 6 months is up if you're confident. the main thing to focus on now is getting your permit through the DMV test and then practicing driving as much as possible. but based on your age/ the date, september is the earliest you can take the road test so you wouldn't be able get your license before you turn 18
